bears.name: Chicago Bears
bears.summary: The Chicago Bears made a major trade deadline move, acquiring All-Pro defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons from the Tennessee Titans to bolster their defensive front , with Tennessee receiving 2027 and 2028 first-round picks plus a 2027 fourth-round pick from the Bears for Simmons and a 2028 fifth-round pick . The blockbuster deal comes as the 5-2 Bears prepare for a Monday Night Football showdown against the defending champion Seattle Seahawks, with Simmons also set to reunite with former Mississippi State teammate Montez Sweat on Chicago's defensive line.

lions.name: Detroit Lions
lions.summary: The Detroit Lions continue preparing for their high-stakes Week 8 showdown against the undefeated Minnesota Vikings, with the team getting a major boost as all seven starters, including Jahmyr Gibbs and Amon-Ra St. Brown, returned to practice ahead of the NFC North matchup .

packers.name: Green Bay Packers
packers.summary: The Green Bay Packers defeated the Carolina Panthers 27-19 on Thursday Night Football, with Jordan Love throwing 3 touchdown passes as the Packers beat the Panthers 27-19 . The win moved Green Bay to 5-3 on the season, though the game saw a dramatic moment when Christian Watson returned to Lambeau Field in an ambulance after being taken to the hospital earlier in the game .

vikings.name: Minnesota Vikings
vikings.summary: The Vikings enter Week 8 at 6-0 as the NFL's last remaining undefeated team, preparing to face the Detroit Lions, with running back Aaron Jones returning to limited practice on Thursday after aggravating a knee injury during last Sunday's win over the Colts . Minnesota also added depth at tight end, as Gavin Bartholomew did not practice due to an ankle injury, meaning the Vikings could elevate Bryson Nesbit or Devin Culp from the practice squad for depth purposes .
